summary: The Impero bath serves as the perfect centrepiece for any Federation or Hamptons style bathroom, where traditional styling seamlessly merges with modern comfort and technology.
title: The Bath That Defines Traditional Sophistication
bodyHtml:
The Bath that Defines Classic Sophistication

The Impero is the ultimate hero piece for any Classic, Hamptons or Period-Style bathroom project. With its beautiful form and exquisite detail, Impero captures the essence of a golden era, reimagined with today’s technology.

See Impero Specifications

Crafted for Comfort & Luxury

Crafted from Studio Bagno’s signature MarmoTech stone composition, the Impero Bath delivers both beauty and functionality.

MarmoTech is a non-porous, 100% silica-free surface that ensures exceptional hygiene while its unique material quickly warms and maintains heat, providing a truly indulgent experience.

Impero is not only luxurious to touch but also safe and durable, making it a standout choice for your bathroom sanctuary.

A Complete Design Solution

The Impero Bath pairs seamlessly with our entire Federation Collection, a curated selection of classic bathroom essentials.

From our best-selling Impero Suite and Impero Wall Faced Pan to a range of basins, consoles, and pedestals, this collection brings harmony and cohesion to your space.

With Impero, you’re not just investing in a bath—you’re creating a timeless design narrative that celebrates classic elegance in every detail.

Discover Impero

Whether you're creating a luxurious sanctuary or adding classic charm to your bathroom, Impero sets the stage for timeless sophistication.

See complete specification and more images by clicking the button below, or call us on (02) 9601 1948 to organise a viewing in our showroom or one of our nationwide distributors.
